subject.title: San Diego County Board of Education, District 3

text: Primary election winner with 57% of the vote!

While serving on the San Diego County Board of Education, I have had the privilege of holding the offices of President and Vice-President. I have served on the Policy Committee, the Legislative Committee for the California County Offices of Education, and on the San Diego Latino Advisory Council.
I have collaborated with teachers and staff to strengthen the San Diego County Office of Education’s efforts to support English language learners, foster and homeless youth, and at-risk youth.
I am dedicated to ensuring students receive the education they need to excel, so they can enter the work force or transfer to college upon graduation.
I hold an M.A. from San Francisco State University, a B.A. from the University of California, Berkeley, and took doctoral classes at San Diego State University and Claremont Graduate University.
At Cuyamaca College, I taught ESL, served as the Academic Senate President, and held the positions of Dean of Instruction and Vice-President of Instruction.
I am endorsed by all of my fellow Board members on the San Diego County Board of Education and I am the only candidate endorsed by the American Federation of Teachers and the San Diego Labor Council!
My experience in education, coupled with my commitment to serving students and the community, make me the right choice to continue serving on the San Diego County Board of Education!
